about: Applied by the installers to Herdr's own `files` mod after cloning it as my-files: YAML files (.yaml/.yml, up to 4000 lines) are drawn by yaml-view.js with keys, values, strings, numbers, booleans/null, anchors, tags and comments in separate colors (Herdr's built-in YAML grammar colors keys and values alike), with its own mouse selection (drag, double/triple click, Shift+click) and Cmd+C / Cmd+A, and other files get a fuller syntax color map. Each find must occur exactly once.
